# About the Author

Kimberlee Centera, president and CEO of TerraPro Solutions, is a trailblazer in renewable energy project development, with over 35 years of expertise in de-risking complex utility-scale projects. She has guided Fortune 500 companies, developers, and investors through high-stakes mergers and acquisitions transactions, ensuring projects remain bankable, insurable, and compliant.

A leading authority, she is a frequent contributor to North American Clean Energy and POWER Magazine, and a sought-after speaker and presenter at energy industry conferences. She has appeared on an extensive array of podcasts and nationally syndicated programs, including National Public Radio.

Kimberlee's career spans the full lifecycle of renewable energy projects—from initial site assessment through financial close and operations. Her expertise encompasses land acquisition, title and mineral rights analysis, environmental due diligence, community engagement, and project financing. She has worked on transactions valued at more than \$25 billion across solar, wind, storage, and transmission projects.

TerraPro Solutions, which she founded, specializes in providing specialized due diligence and risk mitigation services for renewable energy projects, with particular focus on the often-overlooked details that determine whether deals succeed or fail.
